name: W Roma
insider_take: This sleek design hotel occupies a restored 19th-century palazzo just steps from the iconic Via del Corso, where ancient Roman luxury meets cutting-edge contemporary style.
whats_special: The W Roma features a stunning rooftop terrace with panoramic views of the Eternal City, including glimpses of the Pantheon dome. The hotel's signature WOOBAR serves craft cocktails in a dramatically lit space designed by acclaimed architect Flaviano Capriotti, while the building itself was once home to Roman nobility.
pro_tip: Book the rooftop for sunset aperitivo hour – the golden light hitting ancient domes and modern skylines creates the perfect Instagram moment, and locals consider it one of Rome's best-kept secret viewpoints.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you within a 5-minute walk of the Pantheon, Trevi Fountain, and Spanish Steps. The underground Roman ruins discovered during renovation are visible through glass floors in select areas, offering guests a literal glimpse into layers of history beneath their feet.
pros: Prime location near Vatican City and Spanish Steps
Ultra-modern design with vibrant contemporary aesthetics
Rooftop bar with panoramic views of Rome's skyline
High-tech amenities and cutting-edge room features
cons: Bold modern design may not suit traditional preferences
